subject: pushed write_array method to compiled models

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: pushed write_array method to compiled models
parts:
I just pushed a patch to the code generator for
a method to write output in last-index-major order
into a vector. This will let you produce the vectors
to add into the chains class:

// write into vars__ in last-index major order
void write_array(std::vector<double>& params_r__,
std::vector<int>& params_i__,
std::vector<double>& vars__);

To construct the an instance of mcmc::chains for a model,
there are two additional methods:

// write sequence of param names into names__
void get_param_names(std::vector<std::string>& names__)

// write sequence of dims into dimss__
void get_dims(std::vector<std::vector<size_t> >& dimss__)

Sorry that took so long! It turned out to require
more thought than actual code.

- Bob
